title: Remove the typed plane-bus call wrappers from core's pillar crates
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO decision 2026-11-18 (option A): the typed plane-bus call wrappers leave core. Core keeps the plane bus (topics, PlaneBus, PlaneHandler, shared DTO and helpers) and the two wrappers it calls itself (tools::execute_tool, daemon::harness); its pillar crates (susi-gemi, susi-gemi-models, susi-gawd, susi-gawd-swarm, susi-gawd-agents) keep their contracts and stop re-exporting the wrappers. Once Susi Commercial Apps owns them (T-CLAUDEPILLAR-1), delete core's copies and their tests, correct every document that names them and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING.

reuse.searched: Core's susi-core plane_bus and the pillar crates' re-exports; Susi Commercial Apps' agent-runtime. Delete-only: no new code and no dependency.
